name: Hot ginger rice dumplings
summary: Bánh trôi tàu nóng is a soft dumpling of black sesame and mung bean in hot ginger broth, and the ginger stays fragrant after you swallow. One account also puts coconut milk in the broth.
origin: Hạ Long. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, lists it with the salty plates as the sweet.
taste: VnExpress calls the skin soft and the ginger fragrant and sweet.
howToEat: Black sesame and mung bean, in a hot ginger broth. The skin is soft and the ginger stays after you swallow.
Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition, 23 Jul 2021, says the broth is ginger and coconut milk, and gives about 10,000–30,000 đồng a bowl. VnExpress describes the ginger broth.
where: Snack stalls around trường Chuyên Hạ Long and inside chợ Cột 3, phường Hồng Hải, on the VnExpress account. That ward name is from 16 Mar 2021.
seoTitle: Banh troi tau — hot ginger dumplings in Ha Long
seoDescription: Bánh trôi tàu in Hạ Long is a black-sesame and mung-bean dumpling in hot ginger broth. One account also says coconut milk.
